856-5776-6277-8249.description:

Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and On Wings of Gold trigger.
Resolve the On Wings of Gold trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token

Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping O'aka.

Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Squirrel, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.
2757-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to untap basic lands if desired.

When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.

Draw a card.

Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

206-3519-5696.description:
Cast Jyoti from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Jyoti enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad creature token for each time you've cast Jyoti from the command zone this game.
Activate a Forest Dryad by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat steps 3 for each Forest Dryad token created in step 2.
Activate Food Chain by exiling Jyoti, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}{G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Choose to return Jyoti from exile to the command zone.
Activate Food Chain by exiling a Forest Dryad token, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Repeat step 8 for each remaining Forest Dryad token.
Repeat from step 1.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego exiling or tapping the Forest Dryads.

Activate Heart of Ramos by sacrificing it.
Haru triggers, returning Heart of Ramos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1479-3585-5621.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Greensleeves, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Greensleeves trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

When the creature enters the battlefield, Life Finds A Way triggers, creating a token copy of the Wispweaver Angel token.
Repeat from step 4.

Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing Myr Battlesphere and sacrificing the four Myr tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {U}.

Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
